descriptions: The World Government officially renamed this fruit to hide its real identity from history.
The user spent years unable to throw a functional straight punch without stretching backward.
It allows its user's physical heart to beat in a specific rhythm known as the Drums of Liberation.
Its true baseline name is the Mythical Zoan Model: Nika.
The legendary rubber-based fruit consumed by Monkey D. Luffy.
answer: Hito Hito no Mi Model Nika

descriptions: This character's real, biological birth name is officially Alber.
They are the only known surviving member of the fire-manipulating Lunarian race.
They possess a flaming back engine that grants them absolute physical invulnerability when active.
They were broken out of a secure Marine lab by Kaido to serve as his right-hand vanguard.
The black-winged, masked Lead Performer of the Beast Pirates known as King the Conflagration.
This specific weapon is sentient and aggressively tests its user by forcefully draining their physical Haki.
It has a distinct light-violet blade design and belongs to the 21 Great Grade Swords.
It is the only weapon alongside Ame no Habakiri to ever leave a permanent physical scar on Kaido.
It was gifted to a Straw Hat pirate by Kozuki Hiyori in exchange for returning Shusui.
The legendary, Haki-absorbing master sword currently wielded by Roronoa Zoro.
This entity is a massive, centuries-old relic constructed during the ancient Void Century.
It launched a solo assault on Mary Geoise 200 years ago before completely running out of energy.
It fully reactivated on Egghead Island because it recognized the exact heartbeat rhythm of Gear 5 Luffy.
It carries a massive broken sword on its back and telepathically apologized directly to Joy Boy.
The ancient mechanical titan officially designated by Dr. Vegapunk as Emet.
They are the only member of the Straw Hat crew who was born in the North Blue.
They spent the two-year timeskip stranded on a highly dangerous culinary territory called Momoiro Island.
Their genetic modifications awakened on Wano, turning their legs into a blue-flamed Ifrit Jambe.
They belong to the infamous Vinsmoke royal bloodline but completely disowned their family.
The cigarette-smoking, black-suited chef of the Straw Hat Pirates known as Black Leg.
They are the absolute only character in history to have explicitly eaten two different Devil Fruits.
They started their career as an obscure, low-tier recruit on Whitebeard's second division ship.
They orchestrated the mass level 6 breakout from Impel Down to recruit their elite crew.
They control the catastrophic combination of the Yami Yami no Mi and the Gura Gura no Mi.
The sinister Emperor of the Sea whose real name is Marshall D. Teach.
This character spent decades serving as the absolute head executioner of the Gotei-like Holy Knights.
They have a highly noticeable physical silhouette featuring a massive, crescent-moon shaped white hairstyle.
They were personally appointed by Imu to fill the vacancy left after Jaygarcia Saturn's failure.
They are a high-ranking Celestial Dragon ruler who represents the ancient Figarland family lineage.
The ruthless elder warrior who became the new Warrior God of Science and Defense.
This character is legally a massive 65-year-old human who consumed the Nomi Nomi no Mi.
They divided their own brain and personality across six autonomous satellite clones.
They successfully triggered a global post-mortem broadcast revealing that the entire world is sinking.
They were marked for immediate execution by CP0 for illegally researching the forbidden Void Century history.
The supreme, apple-headed master scientist of the Navy whose main core unit is Stella.
This elite group possesses functional immortality and can communicate telepathically across whole oceans.
They do not travel by ship, instead spawning black, numerical magic circles to teleport directly.
They possess awakened, horrific Mythical Zoan beast forms based on Yokai monsters like the Gyuki and Bakotsu.
They rule the entire global structure of the World Government from the Room of Authority.
The cabal of five wrinkly Celestial Dragon overlords who answer only to the secret king, Imu.
This warrior belongs to a nearly extinct, physically massive human race known as the Buccaneers.
They spent their early childhood working as a slave under the absolute abuse of the Celestial Dragons.
They voluntarily surrendered their own biological free will to keep their daughter, Jewelry Bonney, alive.
Their physical body serves as the core template for the Navy's cybernetic Pacifista line.
The gentle-hearted ex-Warlord and Revolutionary army member known as the Tyrant.
This specific weapon is a giant, airborne sky vessel capable of erasing whole islands instantly.
It requires an incredibly advanced, glowing liquid resource called the Mother Flame to operate.
It was successfully utilized by Imu to wipe out Lulusia Kingdom, leaving a massive permanent sea hole.
It represents one of the three catastrophic tools of mass destruction created during the Void Century.
The ancient weapon of the sky that sits alongside Pluton and Poseidon.
This location is a massive, unmapped winter wonderland populated exclusively by giant warrior clans.
It functions as the current hidden storage vault holding all the salvaged book records of Ohara.
It is ruled over by the mysterious Prince Loki and is the homeland of Dorry and Brogy.
It is widely celebrated across the New World as the ultimate land of the Giants.
The major destination island that Luffy and the Straw Hats sail toward immediately after escaping Egghead.
This marine is an official member of the secret, law-exempt naval detachment known as SWORD.
They were kidnapped from Amazon Lily by Blackbeard, sparking a full-scale rescue raid on Hachinosu.
They shocked the world by mastering an advanced, city-destroying Haki punch called Honesty Impact.
The pink-haired, emotional young marine officer who aims to become an Admiral.
Luffy's very first companion from the East Blue who trained under Monkey D. Garp.
This high-ranking traitor clone represents the baseline human personality trait of 'Greed'.
She leaked Vegapunk's illegal Void Century data directly to the Five Elders via a private transponder snail.
She systematically shot and deactivated the other Vegapunk satellites to claim a Celestial Dragon spot.
She sabotaged Egghead's Frontier Dome barrier to trap her allies inside with the Marines.
The freckled, gluttonous Vegapunk clone designated explicitly as Punk 06.
This legendary marine is the only combatant in history to turn down an Admiral promotion multiple times.
They launched a direct, unauthorized assault on Hachinosu to rescue Koby using their custom warship.
They can completely flatten entire cityscapes using a Haki-fused fist strike called Galaxy Impact.
They serve as the direct biological father of Monkey D. Dragon and grandfather to Luffy.
The legendary, dog-mask wearing Marine Vice Admiral universally celebrated as the Hero.
This character is the biological son of the legendary 'King of the Pirates', Gol D. Roger.
They consumed the Logia-type Mera Mera no Mi, granting them total control over fire.
They served as the Commander of the Whitebeard Pirates' Second Division for years.
Their tragic execution at Marineford triggered the absolute largest summit war in modern pirate history.
Luffy's beloved adoptive older brother who was famously known as 'Fire Fist'.
This character is an elite CP0 agent whose physical body was cloned directly from Buckingham Stussy.
They spent years operating as a deep-cover double agent inside the World Government's highest intelligence tier.
They possess bat-like wings and can put targets to sleep instantly by biting their neck with vampire fangs.
They chose to betray their Cipher Pol allies on Egghead because their true core loyalty belongs to Vegapunk.
The fishnet-wearing clone agent who operates as the hidden asset of the Future Island labs.
This Devil Fruit grants its user a highly unique space-manipulation room capability called 'Chambre'.
The World Government valued this specific fruit at an astronomical price of 5 billion berries.
It grants the user the ability to perform the legendary Perennial Youth Operation at the cost of their own life.
It is a Paramecia-type fruit that allows its user to telekinetically scan and slice objects inside a glowing blue dome.
The medical-based fruit consumed by the 'Surgeon of Death', Trafalgar D. Water Law.
This legendary Wano country warrior is the only individual who ever naturally tamed the Haki-draining sword, Enma.
They traveled out to sea as a temporary member of both the Whitebeard Pirates and the Roger Pirates.
They danced in the streets of the Flower Capital for five years to protect captured citizens from Orochi.
They met a tragic, legendary death by executing an hour-long execution survival inside a boiling oil pot.
The grand Daimyo of Kuri who wielded the legendary two-sword style and fathered Momonosuke.
This island was completely erased from all standard maps 38 years ago due to a horrific incident.
It served as the chaotic battlefield where the Rocks Pirates were permanently dismantled.
It hosted a horrific, tournament-style hunting game orchestrated by the Celestial Dragons.
Monkey D. Garp and Gol D. Roger formed a legendary temporary alliance here to protect the slaves.
The vanished historical island where the Rocks Pirates met their ultimate downfall.
